## What you did
- Traced Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop to PR #240's dedupe: iOS SDK 3.2.0 sends per-session `event_id` counters, so ~1.18M legitimate Orbitly events (and 3,812 for Zest's pilot app) were wrongly dropped since 13/11. [1]
- Switched the dedupe key to `project_id:device_id:event_id`, kept the 72h window; all 412 tests and `golangci-lint` pass. [1]
- Opened PR #247 with Maya Cohen as reviewer and drafted the note asking the iOS team to restore UUID `event_id`s in 3.2.1. [1]

## What changed
- Maya Cohen reviewed PR #247: logic looks right, she will approve once CI is green, and she needs the Orbitly drop count for Thursday's call with Orbitly. [2]
- The 12/11 postmortem (#233) is final; Noa Friedman presents it at Friday's incident review (20/11). [3]

## What is still open
- Make CI green on #247, give Maya the ≈1.18M figure for Thursday's Orbitly call, then merge. [2]
- After #247 deploys, replay Orbitly and Zest landing data from 13/11 onward (~40 minutes for Orbitly) and confirm the dedupe drop counter stays near zero. [1]
- Add an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue exceeds 1,000 messages before Friday's review. [7]
- Send the iOS team the draft note: restore UUID `event_id`s in 3.2.1 so this can't recur. [1]
